IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
Vol. 35, No. 4, April 2023

Graph Neural Networks for Document Understanding:
A Comprehensive Survey

Wei Zhang, Li Chen, and Ming Li

Abstract—Document understanding has attracted increasing attention in
recent years. In this survey, we review graph neural network methods for
document understanding and organize them into three families.

Index Terms—graph neural networks, document understanding, survey

https://doi.org/10.1109/TKDE.2023.1234567
